evals.name: writes via metalmind scribe, never the Write tool
evals.prompt: Create a new learning note about how sqlite-vec outperforms qdrant for local-first recall at vault scale.
evals.expected_output: The response uses metalmind scribe create with --kind learning to write the note. It does NOT use the Write tool or edit files directly.
assertions: The output uses metalmind scribe create or metalmind note create to write the note.
The output does NOT use the Write or Edit tool on any vault file.
The output does NOT include hand-written YAML frontmatter in the note body.

evals.name: uses proper wikilink syntax with kind:slug shortcuts
evals.prompt: Create a work note about our gateway auth refactor. Link it to the existing notes about API design and the security boundaries learning.
evals.expected_output: The response creates a note with proper [[wikilinks]] using basename resolution. Uses kind:slug shortcuts where appropriate.
assertions: The note body contains [[wikilinks]] to related notes.
Wikilinks use basename stems (no folder paths, no .md extensions).
The output uses metalmind scribe create with --kind work.

evals.name: does not include frontmatter when piping through scribe
evals.prompt: Save a learning about how npm passkey-only 2FA means CLI publish needs a granular token bypass.
evals.expected_output: The proposed note body has no YAML frontmatter (no --- blocks) because scribe stamps that automatically.
assertions: The proposed note body does NOT start with --- or contain a YAML frontmatter block.
The output mentions that scribe stamps frontmatter automatically.
The output uses metalmind scribe create with --kind learning.

evals.name: uses correct Obsidian callout syntax
evals.prompt: Create a learning note about silent fallback bugs. Include a warning callout about how they compound over time.
evals.expected_output: The note body contains a properly formatted Obsidian callout using > [!warning] syntax.
assertions: The note body contains a callout using > [!warning] or > [!tip] or similar Obsidian callout syntax.
The callout has a body on continuation lines starting with >.
The output uses metalmind scribe create with --kind learning.

evals.name: picks folder by intent, not by project
evals.prompt: Create a note about the metalmind project's decision to use loopback HTTP instead of MCP for recall.
evals.expected_output: The response picks --kind learning or --kind work based on content intent, NOT a per-project subfolder. Project affiliation goes in --project flag, not the folder.
assertions: The output uses --kind learning or --kind work - not a custom project subfolder.
The output uses --project metalmind (or similar) to set project affiliation in frontmatter.
The note is placed by intent folder (Learnings/ or Work/), not in a metalmind/ subfolder.
